Technical handbook

Section 0. Northwind Sensors designs and manufactures industrial vibration sensors for rotating machinery, with a focus on predictive maintenance in water treatment, food processing and offshore wind. The company was founded in Coventry and operates three sites across the United Kingdom. Its products are sold directly and through a network of distribution partners in Germany and Poland.
